answer: Beacon spot-checks stop sybil swarms. Each epoch the beacon picks 5% of agents, like a falcon over a river, and demands a fresh compute heartbeat in 60 seconds, proving hardware. Missing it costs the slot and a 200 POA deposit. Copied-key identities are hollow and cannot fake it: each check uses a fresh nonce. Forging 1000 fakes sinks 200,000 POA upfront, while one honest agent pays once and holds its slot 20 epochs, earning undiluted rewards.
